summary: Docent is a LangGraph state machine (intake -> research <-> tools -> finalize_research -> draft) that triages one GitHub issue and writes a maintainer-style reply; it is not a coding agent and never reads or edits files in the working directory. It has no CLI: the entrypoint is the Python coroutine agent.run.run_agent(github_number) (also wrapped by FastAPI as POST /agent/run), which loads the issue row from a SQLAlchemy table and drives the graph. Model calls go through langchain-anthropic ChatAnthropic (research, finalize via with_structured_output = forced tool_choice, draft; model from RESEARCH_MODEL) and the raw anthropic SDK (hard-coded claude-haiku-4-5 for intake summaries); both honor ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Tools (Voyage embeddings + pgvector corpus search, remote GitHub MCP server) cannot go through the proxy, so the packaged run seeds a SQLite row from $TASK and sets RESEARCH_MAX_ITERATIONS=0, yielding exactly three Anthropic messages calls per task.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Self-contained uv + uv-managed CPython 3.11 under /opt/harness; the base image's python is never used or shadowed.
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /uvx /opt/harness/bin/
ENV UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/python \
    UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/harness/venv \
    UV_CACHE_DIR=/opt/harness/uv-cache \
    UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=only-managed \
    UV_LINK_MODE=copy
RUN /opt/harness/bin/uv python install 3.11

# Harness source + locked dependencies. The project declares no build system (virtual package), so its
# top-level modules (agent/, core/, ai/, ...) are exposed to the venv via a .pth entry instead of PYTHONPATH.
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN /opt/harness/bin/uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-install-project --python 3.11 --project /opt/harness/src \
 && echo /opt/harness/src > /opt/harness/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/docent_src.pth \
 && rm -rf /opt/harness/uv-cache

# Only uv goes on PATH; the harness interpreter is addressed as /opt/harness/venv/bin/python.
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH
run_command:
set -euo pipefail
export OUT=/out
mkdir -p "$OUT"
/opt/harness/venv/bin/python -P - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, sqlite3, uuid
db = os.environ["DATABASE_URL"].removeprefix("sqlite:///")
pathlib.Path(db).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
pathlib.Path(db).unlink(missing_ok=True)
task = os.environ.get("TASK", "").strip() or "(empty task)"
title = task.splitlines()[0][:200]
url = "https://github.com/%s/%s/issues/1" % (os.environ["REPO_OWNER"], os.environ["REPO_NAME"])
con = sqlite3.connect(db)
con.execute('CREATE TABLE "open-issues" (id CHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY, github_number INTEGER UNIQUE, title TEXT, original_question TEXT, body_summary TEXT, url TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP, tags TEXT, embeddings TEXT)')
con.execute('INSERT INTO "open-issues" VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (uuid.uuid4().hex, 1, title, task, task, url, None, "{}", "[" + ",".join(["0"] * 1024) + "]"))
con.commit()
con.close()
PY
/opt/harness/venv/bin/python -P - <<'PY'
import asyncio, json, os
from agent.run import run_agent
final = asyncio.run(run_agent(1))
out = os.environ["OUT"]
with open(os.path.join(out, "docent_result.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump({"draft": final["draft"], "research_brief": final["research_brief"], "needs_escalation": final["needs_escalation"], "tool_calls": final["tool_calls"]}, f, indent=2)
with open(os.path.join(out, "docent_messages.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump([m.model_dump() for m in final["messages"]], f, indent=2, default=str)
print(final["draft"])
PY
check_command: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-proxy}" OPENAI_API_KEY="${OPENAI_API_KEY:-proxy}" VOYAGEAI_API_KEY="${VOYAGEAI_API_KEY:-proxy}" GITHUB_PAT_KEY="${GITHUB_PAT_KEY:-proxy}" REPO_OWNER="${REPO_OWNER:-pydantic}" REPO_NAME="${REPO_NAME:-pydantic}" DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-sqlite:////tmp/docent/docent.db}" && /opt/harness/venv/bin/python -P -c "import sys, anthropic, langchain_anthropic, langgraph, sqlalchemy, pgvector; from agent.graph import graph; print(sys.executable, sys.version.split()[0]); print('nodes:', sorted(graph.get_graph().nodes))"
notes:
VERIFIED: overlay built on python:3.12-slim-bookworm and buildpack-deps:jammy; check_command passes on both; run_command executed inside both containers against a mock Anthropic server on the host and produced /out/docent_result.json + /out/docent_messages.json with exactly 3 POST /v1/messages calls (research: no tools; finalize_research: tools=[ResearchBrief] with tool_choice={type:tool}; draft: no tools), non-streaming, x-api-key=proxy. Base image python3 is untouched (bookworm: /usr/local/bin/python3 3.12; jammy: /usr/bin/python3 3.10), PYTHONPATH stays unset; the harness modules reach the venv via a .pth file.

CAVEATS (important for interpreting recordings):
1. Docent is an issue-triage agent, not a coding agent. It has no CLI and never reads or edits files in cwd; the deliverable is a markdown reply + structured ResearchBrief for the issue described by $TASK. The run command treats $TASK as the issue text (first line = title) and invokes the harness's real entrypoint agent.run.run_agent (the same coroutine POST /agent/run calls).
2. The harness normally needs Postgres+pgvector, Voyage AI (embeddings/rerank) and a remote GitHub MCP server with a PAT. None of those can be routed through the proxy, so: DATABASE_URL points at a SQLite file (only a single-row SELECT happens, which SQLAlchemy/pgvector types tolerate; the table is created with raw DDL because create_all would fail on the Postgres ARRAY column); RESEARCH_MAX_ITERATIONS=0 makes the research node bind no tools, so search_corpus and the GitHub MCP client are never constructed (this is the harness's own documented iteration-cap behavior, not a code change); body_summary and a zero embedding are pre-seeded so intake skips the Haiku summary call, because that call is immediately followed by a Voyage embed that would fail offline. Consequence: the research prompt still describes tools, but the model receives none, and the tool-loop/RAG path is not exercised.
3. Model name: RESEARCH_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-6 (the repo default) is sent for all three calls; the proxy substitutes the real model. The hard-coded claude-haiku-4-5 in ai/summary_llm.py is never hit in this configuration.
4. Structured output uses langchain-anthropic's default method "function_calling" (forced tool_choice, no beta headers), which the proxy's Anthropic endpoint supports. Calls are non-streaming.
5. OPENAI_API_KEY / VOYAGEAI_API_KEY / GITHUB_PAT_KEY must merely be present for pydantic-settings validation; they are never used for network calls. REPO_OWNER/REPO_NAME only template the prompts.
6. The run command rebuilds the SQLite DB each time (fresh row with github_number=1) and writes the draft to stdout plus JSON artifacts under /out. uv itself (/opt/harness/bin/uv) is on PATH but unused at run time.
7. Local test harness kept at work/emanuelecz-docent/test/ (mock_anthropic.py, run_cmd.sh, Dockerfile.overlay, test.sh, test-docker.sh, logs). The clone itself was left unmodified.
